claims.statement: Rakdos is the black-red guild of Ravnica, associated with performance, chaos, hedonism, cruelty, and anti-authoritarian expression.
The official guide describes the Cult of Rakdos as entertainers and hosts whose performances may be destructive or hedonistic.
The guide says Rakdos was loosely organized into Rings and later pushed toward travelling theater-troupe behavior.
The guide identifies the ancient demon Rakdos as founder, namesake, and object of cultic worship.
Spectacle is the Ravnica Allegiance signature mechanic associated with Rakdos.
Rakdos placement signals should weight intensity, transgression, expressive honesty, dark humor, and impatience with empty restraint.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
